Question 2
?

From top to bottom, what are the missing expressions in the following polynomial division problem?

2x2−x+23x−16x3−5x2+7x+46x3−2x2―3x3−3x2+7x+43x3−3x2+x―3x3−6x2−6x+43x3−6x2−6x−2―3x3−6x2−6x−6

a
2x2−2x+1 and −3x2+x
b
2x2+x+2 and +3x2−x
c
2x2−x+2 and −3x2+x
d
2x2+2x+1 and 6x2+x
e
2x2−2x+2 and −6x2+x
